## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] UI strings are bilingual (`/*@en*/` + `/*@zh*/` in `dict.ts`) — if applicable
- [ ] No secrets, keys, or personal data in the diff (no `.env.local`, nothing under `data/`)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s` / DCO)
- [ ] Stays local-first (no new cloud dependency; growth data never leaves the machine)
